title: aidd autopilot next --json
description: What `aidd autopilot next --json` prints. Autopilot runs the AIDD loop between your decisions: aidd decides each next step and stops whenever a person must decide. `run` names a team command for an agent step; `ask` names a person's decision and the page to read; `stop` says why the run ends. Agents never approve or merge on their own. Under the person's standing approval (`approve all`), `run` names the approvals it covers as aidd commands: `aidd approve spec`, `aidd approve merge`, and `aidd ship`.

schema_version.description: The version of this output's shape. A new key keeps it; a renamed, removed, or retyped key bumps it.

code.description: The step code acted on. `aidd autopilot note` records the result against it.

flow.description: run: the flow whose `starts_on` names the code (roles.json).

command.description: run: the team command, such as `/aidd-team:implement`, or, under the person's standing approval, an aidd command the session runs in its shell on the Spec's branch: `aidd approve spec` (with the Spec's path in `args`), `aidd approve merge`, or `aidd ship`.

args.description: run: its argument: the Spec id, or the goal.

spec.description: The item the action is about, when there is one.

work.description: The lease's work: a Spec, Epic, or Initiative id, a label, or `all`.

who.description: ask: who decides, as `aidd list` names them.

what.description: ask: the decision, in a sentence.

how.description: ask: how the person decides it.

page.description: ask: the command that writes the decision page.

waiting.description: ask: how many decisions wait in the work.

blocked.description: ask: true when the run cannot go on until a person acts: a Task out of retries, the circuit breaker, a stop rule, or a setup problem.

reason.description: stop: why the run ends. `plan_ready`: the plan or proposal is ready, and only a person starting autopilot again agrees to it and goes on. `stalled`: the last steps moved nothing on, so a person looks first.

session_id.description: The session that holds the lease.

work.description: The lease's work: a Spec, Epic, or Initiative id, a label, or `all`.

expires_at.description: When the lease's timebox ends, in UTC.

limits.description: The `autopilot` limits in force, shown once when autopilot starts.

paused.description: What the run set aside, each for one reason: paused with `blocked_on`, a Task out of retries, a stop rule, or the circuit breaker. Other runnable work goes on.

decisions.description: ask, or a stop a person ends (plan_ready, timebox, token_cap, cost_cap): every decision in the work that waits on a person, in `aidd list`'s order. Blocked work is not one: `behind` counts it.

how.description: How to take it, with the command.

behind.description: ask, or a stop a person ends: how many items in the work are blocked and start when what they wait on finishes.

resume.description: ask, or a stop a person ends: the command that goes on once a person has decided (or is ready), as this install names it, such as `/aidd-team:autopilot all`.

message.description: ask, or a stop a person ends: what the autopilot command shows the person, word for word: why the run stopped, each decision and how to take it, and the `resume` command.

also.description: With `run`: more steps to run at the same time as this one, at most `autopilot.parallel` minus one. Each is a team flow on another Spec whose Tasks' scopes overlap none of the others', run in its own worktree on its Spec's branch. Each is recorded with its own `aidd autopilot note`.

flow.description: The team flow that runs it.

command.description: The team command to run, as in `command`.
